technical_summary: POC: integrate IDE plugin (VSCode) using gRPC/streaming completions, plus RAG for repo search. Requirements: per-file and function-level chunking (prefer boundary-aware chunks), incremental embedding updates for mono-repo, prefix/KV cache for hot files, and model/version pinning for predictable completions. Vector DB must be deployable inside customer VPC or on-prem with no external egress. Need benchmark: 10k embedding ops/min per 8 GPU pool, 50ms p50 token streaming latency from IDE to model on dedicated capacity. Interested in Redwood's Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization profiles to reduce cost without degrading token-level latencies.
business_value: Goal: ship a first-class IDE copilot that uses repository context (function-scoped embeds + cross-file references) to improve relevance and reduce hallucination. Expected outcomes: 30% fewer context-switches for engineers, 20% faster PR turnaround. Primary buying criteria: privacy/residency, predictable latency for streaming completions, and unit cost at scale.
